title: MP Minister Vijayvargiy Says Muslims Should Avoid His Roads
summary: Madhya Pradesh minister Kailash Vijayvargiy made controversial remarks during a road inauguration in Indour, stating that those who call him 'kafir' should not use his roads. The statement has sparked political debate on social media.
summary_points: Minister Kailash Vijayvargiy spoke at the inauguration of a ₹125 crore road project in Indaur.
title_hi: मध्य प्रदेश मंत्री काफिर कहने वालों को अपनी सड़कों पर मत चलना
